name: context_menu
title: Context Menu
description: A menu that opens at the pointer on right click.

attributes.name: data-context-menu
attributes.description: Wraps the trigger area and the menu popover.

attributes.name: data-context-menu-target="content"
attributes.description: The menu to show. Use the popover--unanchored modifier so it can be placed at the pointer.

actions.name: show
actions.description: Moves the menu to the pointer position and opens it.

actions.name: hide
actions.description: Closes the menu unless the click happened inside it.
